concerns.text: The plan relies on a *deterministic synthetic surrogate* of 50 failed figure generations because a verified CrafterBench source is unavailable (see line: “curates a deterministic synthetic surrogate of 50 failed figure generations (used for CI verification; the real CrafterBench subset is currently unavailable as a verified open source)”). FR‑001 explicitly requires the system to **download and curate a static subset of exactly 50 failed figure generations from the CrafterBench dataset**. Using synthetic data does not satisfy this requirement and may be inappropriate for the human‑subject study, potentially compromising external validity.
